original_text:
My friend switched from SDE to Data Engineering and got placed at 20+ LPA.

Here is the roadmap I told him to follow:

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟭: 𝗦𝗤𝗟
- Basic SQL Syntax
- DDL, DML, DCL
- Joins & Subqueries
- Views & Indexes
- CTEs & Window Functions

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟮: 𝗣𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻
- Fundamentals
- Numpy
- Pandas

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟯-𝟰: 𝗣𝘆𝘀𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸
- RDD's
- Dataframes
- Datasets
- Spark Streaming
- Optimization Techniques

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟱: 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗪𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗵𝗼𝘀𝘂𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴
- OLAP vs OLTP
- Star & Snowflake Schema
- Fact & Dimension Tables
- Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟲: 𝗖𝗜/𝗖𝗗 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀
- Merging and Pull Requests
- Git Hooks
- Pipeline Configuration
- Infrastructure as Code

𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸 𝟳-𝟴: 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱 𝗦𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗰𝗲𝘀
- NoSQL DB
- Relational DB
- Data Warehousing
- Scheduling & Orchestration
- Messaging
- ETL Services
- Storage Services
- Data Processing Services

Free resources to learn these skills.

Airflow - https://lnkd.in/guebuHJ7
Kafka - https://lnkd.in/gVZUT52s
Data Modeling - https://lnkd.in/gg6V98Ru
Azure Cloud - https://lnkd.in/gwc3By9h
Google Cloud - https://lnkd.in/gNwpp2RT
AWS - https://lnkd.in/gJeUGfjS
Mock Interviews - https://lnkd.in/gV_5EFtE

𝗜 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝗻 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗵 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝟭𝟬𝟬+ 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀.

𝗚𝗲𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲𝘀 𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗲 - https://lnkd.in/giY6RZu2

If you've read so far, do LIKE the post👍

ai_analysis.summary: The post opens with an anecdotal claim that a friend switched from SDE to Data Engineering and was placed at 20+ LPA. It then presents an eight-week learning roadmap: Week 1 covers SQL, Week 2 covers Python fundamentals, NumPy, and Pandas, Weeks 3-4 cover PySpark topics, and later weeks cover data warehousing, data modeling, CI/CD pipeline practices, and broad cloud-service categories. A separate resource list includes links labeled SQL, Python, PySpark, Airflow, Kafka, Data Modeling, Azure Cloud, Google Cloud, AWS, and Mock Interviews. The post names subjects but does not explain or compare them, and it ends with a truncated "...see more" marker with no extracted media text.

interview_questions.question: Which SQL capabilities are prioritized in Week 1 of the roadmap?
interview_questions.answer: A complete answer lists basic SQL syntax, DDL, DML, DCL, joins, subqueries, views, indexes, CTEs, and window functions.

interview_questions.question: Which Python and PySpark topics are assigned to Weeks 2 through 4?
interview_questions.answer: A complete answer identifies Python fundamentals, NumPy, and Pandas in Week 2, followed by RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, Spark Streaming, and optimization techniques in Weeks 3-4.

interview_questions.question: Which data warehousing and modeling subjects are explicitly included in the roadmap?
interview_questions.answer: A complete answer includes OLAP versus OLTP, star and Snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and Slowly Changing Dimensions.
